meta.provenance: Seen before this analysis: the seed-3401 D_ATTENTION lag-arm results (D_ATTENTION_RESULTS.md, d_lag.json), including the degenerate native learned_temporal column. The panel's legacy fixed-order AT-INTEGRATOR values (3407, 3413, seed mean; unified and native) had been computed and written by the R34_D_PANEL lane of the same session (d_multiseed.json 20:01, D_MULTI_SEED_RESULTS.md §1.6 20:03) before this track's design was finalised; this lane did not read them (note §11.1), and here they are reproduction targets, not new evidence. The policy-arm attention values had never been aggregated and were not read. Every paired-order value (AO-PAIRED-LEGACY, AO-ANTISYM) and every policy-arm aggregate in this document is computed for the first time by this run.
